news.n_rus_vladimir_kiev: They say Vladimir, son of Svyatoslav, has come back from overseas with Varangians and taken Kiev, and his brother Yaropolk is dead.
news.n_rus_varangian_martyrs: In Kiev a mob killed two Christian Varangians, father and son, who refused to give the son as a sacrifice to the idols.
news.n_rus_envoys: The prince's envoys have returned from Constantinople and say of the service in Holy Wisdom: "We knew not whether we were in heaven or on earth."
news.n_rus_anna: Princess Anna, sister of the emperors, has been brought from Constantinople to marry Prince Vladimir.
news.n_rus_pereyaslavl: A new town, Pereyaslavl, has been built on the Trubezh. They say a young tanner defeated a Pecheneg champion on that spot.
news.n_rus_tithe: The stone church of the Mother of God in Kiev has been consecrated; the prince has given it a tithe.
news.n_rus_olaf: Varangians say the Norwegian king Olaf, who once lived at the court in Novgorod, has died in a sea battle.
news.n_rus_otto: They say the young German emperor Otto has died in Italy.
news.n_rus_bulgar_trade: They say the prince has agreed free river trade with the Volga Bulgars.
news.n_rus_lithuania: They say that on the Baltic coast pagan Lithuanians have killed a Latin missionary.
news.n_rus_basil: Greeks say Emperor Basil has crushed the Bulgarians and blinded thousands of captives.
news.n_rus_boleslaw: King Boleslaw of Poland and Svyatopolk have taken Kiev. Yaroslav fled to Novgorod and wanted to go overseas, but the Novgorodians hacked his boats apart.
news.n_rus_listven: Mstislav of Tmutarakan has beaten Yaroslav at Listven. And in Suzdal there is famine, and seers have stirred up the people.
news.n_rus_divide: The brothers Yaroslav and Mstislav have divided Rus along the Dnieper and live in peace.
news.n_rus_yuriev: Prince Yaroslav has campaigned against the Chud and founded the town of Yuriev.
news.n_rus_pechenegs_near: They say the Pechenegs are roaming near the Ros again, stealing cattle.
news.n_rus_golden_gate: The Golden Gate has been built in Kiev and St Sophia founded on the site of the battle with the Pechenegs.
news.n_rus_books: They say Prince Yaroslav has gathered scribes and ordered books translated from Greek. "Books are rivers that water the world."
news.n_rus_tsargrad_campaign: A fleet of boats sailed against Constantinople, but a storm scattered them. Many did not return.
news.n_rus_mazovia: Prince Yaroslav has marched against the Mazovians to help his Polish brother-in-law.
news.n_rus_hilarion: For the first time a native of Rus, Hilarion, has been made metropolitan. And in the caves above the Dnieper the monk Anthony is gathering a brotherhood.
news.n_rus_yaroslav_dies: Yaroslav the Wise has died. Before his death he bade his sons love one another.
news.n_rus_polovtsy: New nomads, the Polovtsians under Khan Bolush, have come to Pereyaslavl. For now they left in peace.
news.n_rus_polovtsy_raid: The Polovtsians have come at war for the first time and beaten the prince of Pereyaslavl.
news.n_rus_vseslav_novgorod: Prince Vseslav of Polotsk has taken Novgorod and carried off the bells of St Sophia. And Varangians say that across the sea a Norman duke has conquered England.
news.n_rus_alta: The Polovtsians have beaten the princes on the Alta; there is said to be a rising in Kiev.
news.n_rus_manzikert: Greek merchants are in tears: the Turks have defeated the emperor and taken him prisoner.
news.n_rus_theodosius: Abbot Theodosius of the Caves has died.
news.n_rus_nezhatina: Prince Izyaslav has been killed at Nezhatina Niva.
news.n_rus_oleg_return: Prince Oleg has returned to Tmutarakan from captivity among the Greeks.
news.n_rus_yaropolk: Prince Yaropolk Izyaslavich has been killed on the road by one of his own men.
news.n_rus_theodosius_relics: The relics of Theodosius of the Caves have been moved into the church; everyone says they are incorrupt.
news.n_rus_locusts: In summer locusts swarmed in and devoured the grass and grain.
news.n_rus_vasilko: The princes had barely left Lyubech when Prince Vasilko of Terebovl was blinded. Feuding again.
news.n_rus_jerusalem: Pilgrims say Latin knights have taken Jerusalem.
news.n_rus_peace_polovtsy: The princes have made peace with the Polovtsians at Sakov. For how long?
news.n_rus_dolobsk: At Lake Dolobsk the princes decided to strike the Polovtsians in spring.
news.n_rus_daniel: Abbot Daniel has returned from the Holy Land, where he set a lamp at the Holy Sepulchre "on behalf of all the land of Rus".
news.n_rus_vladimir_town: Monomakh has fortified the little town of Vladimir on the Klyazma and built a church there.
news.n_rus_salnitsa_news: The princes have routed the Polovtsians on the Salnitsa! News of the victory has reached the Greeks and Rome.
news.n_rus_monomakh_kiev: Vladimir Monomakh has taken the throne of Kiev.
news.n_rus_chronicle: Abbot Sylvester has copied out the chronicle, the Tale of Bygone Years: where the land of Rus came from.
news.n_rus_templars: Pilgrims say that in Jerusalem a group of knights has sworn to guard the roads to the holy places.
news.n_rus_concordat: German merchants say the emperor and the Pope have finally made peace.
news.n_rus_monomakh_dies: Vladimir Monomakh has died. He left his children an Instruction: do not be lazy, do not lie, rise before the sun.
news.n_rus_famine_novgorod: There is famine in Novgorod: people eat lime leaves and birch bark, and the dead cannot be buried fast enough.
news.n_rus_mstislav_dies: Mstislav the Great has died. They say "now the whole land of Rus will be torn apart."
news.n_rus_novgorod_free: The Novgorodians have thrown out their prince and now choose their own.
news.n_rus_vsevolod_olgovich: Vsevolod Olgovich has driven out Monomakh's heirs and taken Kiev.
news.n_rus_edessa: Greeks say the Saracens have taken Edessa. The Latins are preparing another crusade.
news.n_rus_moscow_first: Prince Yury Dolgoruky invited an ally: "Come to me, brother, at Moskov." There was a "mighty feast".
news.n_rus_pereslavl: Prince Yury has founded the town of Pereslavl-Zalessky on Lake Kleshchino.
news.n_rus_vladimir_icon: Andrei, son of Yury, has secretly carried a wonder-working Greek icon of the Mother of God from Vyshgorod to the north.
news.n_rus_assumption: A white-stone Cathedral of the Dormition has been founded in Vladimir.
news.n_rus_euphrosyne: In Polotsk the master Lazar Bogsha has made a precious cross for Abbess Euphrosyne.
news.n_rus_nerl: On the meadow where the Nerl meets the Klyazma a white church of the Intercession has been built; they say it is wonderfully beautiful.
news.n_rus_kiev_sacked: Andrei Bogolyubsky's army has taken and plundered Kiev.
news.n_rus_znamenie_news: Novgorod has beaten off the Suzdalian army; captives are selling for next to nothing.
news.n_rus_andrei_killed: Grand Prince Andrei has been murdered by conspirators at Bogolyubovo.
news.n_rus_vsevolod: Vsevolod, Andrei's brother, has taken the throne of Vladimir. He has so many children they call him Big Nest.
news.n_rus_orel: Svyatoslav of Kiev has routed the Polovtsians on the Orel and captured Khan Kobyak.
news.n_rus_saladin: The pilgrims are grieving: Sultan Saladin has taken Jerusalem.
news.n_rus_barbarossa: German merchants say their emperor Frederick, on his way to the crusade, has drowned in a river.
news.n_rus_svyatoslav_dies: Grand Prince Svyatoslav Vsevolodovich of Kiev, the terror of the Polovtsians, has died.
news.n_rus_dmitrievsky: In Vladimir the Cathedral of St Demetrius is finished, its walls covered in carved beasts and birds.
news.n_rus_roman: Roman Mstislavich has united Galicia and Volhynia into one principality.
news.n_rus_constantinople: Terrible news: the Latin crusaders have taken and plundered Constantinople.
news.n_rus_genghis: Far to the east, in the steppes, the nomad chiefs have proclaimed Temujin as Genghis Khan. Nobody here knew of it then.
news.n_rus_vsevolod_dies: Vsevolod Big Nest has died. His sons are already quarrelling over the inheritance.
news.n_rus_lipitsa: On the Lipitsa the Novgorodians and Mstislav the Bold routed the Suzdalian princes. Thousands fell.
news.n_rus_khwarezm: Merchants from the Volga say an unknown people is ravaging the lands beyond the Caspian.
news.n_rus_nizhny: Grand Prince Yury has founded the town of Nizhny Novgorod where the Oka meets the Volga.
news.n_rus_kalka_news: The unknown Tatars have routed the princes on the Kalka.
news.n_rus_genghis_dies: They say Genghis, great khan of the Tatars, has died.
news.n_rus_novgorod_hunger: There is terrible famine in Novgorod; the burial pits are full.
news.n_rus_omovzha: Prince Yaroslav has beaten the Germans on the Emajõgi.
news.n_rus_volga_bulgaria: Refugees from the Volga say the Tatars have ravaged Great Bulgar.
news.n_rus_torzhok: The Tatars took Torzhok but turned back a hundred versts short of Novgorod because of the spring thaw.
news.n_rus_kiev_falls: Kiev has been taken by Batu.
news.n_rus_yarlyk: Prince Yaroslav Vsevolodovich has gone to Batu and received a yarlyk, a patent for the grand princely throne.
news.n_rus_mikhail: Mikhail of Chernigov has been killed in the Horde for refusing to bow to the fire and the idols.
news.n_rus_carpini: They say an envoy of the Roman Pope has passed through Rus to the Horde and back.
news.n_rus_nevryuy: Nevryuy's army has ravaged Pereslavl-Zalessky. Alexander Nevsky has become grand prince.
news.n_rus_census_news: The Horde's census takers are counting Rus for tribute.
news.n_rus_besermen: In Rostov, Vladimir and Suzdal the people rose and drove out the Muslim tax farmers of the Horde.
news.n_rus_nevsky_dies: Alexander Nevsky has died on his way back from the Horde. The metropolitan said: "The sun of the land of Rus has set."
news.n_rus_rakovor: The Novgorodians fought the Germans and Danes at Rakovor. The slaughter was unheard of.
news.n_rus_novgorod_yaroslav: The Novgorodians wanted to expel Prince Yaroslav Yaroslavich, but the metropolitan persuaded them to make peace.
news.n_rus_kirill_council: In Vladimir Metropolitan Kirill held a council and denounced drunkenness and greedy priests.
news.n_rus_second_census: The Horde is counting people again.
news.n_rus_kublai: Merchants from the Horde say Khan Kublai has conquered all of southern China.
news.n_rus_kavgadyi: Prince Andrei brought the Horde against his brother Dmitry, and they ravaged Murom, Suzdal and Pereslavl.
news.n_rus_tsarevich_driven: Prince Andrei brought a Horde prince again, but Dmitry Alexandrovich drove him off.
news.n_rus_rostov_veche: In Rostov the townsfolk gathered in assembly and drove the Horde men out of the city.
news.n_rus_acre: Pilgrims say the last Latin city in the Holy Land has fallen.
news.n_rus_dyuden_news: Dyuden's army has burned fourteen towns in the north-east.
news.n_rus_maxim: Metropolitan Maximus has left ruined Kiev for Vladimir.
news.n_rus_pereslavl_moscow: The childless prince of Pereslavl has left his domain to Daniel of Moscow.
news.n_rus_tver: Mikhail of Tver has received the patent for the grand princely throne. Moscow and Tver are now enemies.
news.n_rus_peter_metropolitan: Abbot Peter from Volhynia has been made the new metropolitan of all Rus.
news.n_rus_uzbek: They say the new khan of the Horde, Uzbek, has adopted the faith of Muhammad.
news.n_rus_bortenevo: Mikhail of Tver has beaten Yury of Moscow at Bortenevo and captured his wife.
news.n_rus_mikhail_killed: Mikhail of Tver has been executed in the Horde.
news.n_rus_oreshek: Novgorod has made a perpetual peace with the Swedes at the fortress of Oreshek.
news.n_rus_peter_moscow: Metropolitan Peter has moved to Moscow and founded a stone cathedral there.
news.n_rus_tver_rising: The people of Tver have slaughtered the khan's kinsman Cholkhan and his men. Ivan of Moscow is leading a Horde army against Tver.
news.n_rus_kalita_novgorod: They say Ivan Kalita is demanding "silver from beyond the Kama" from Novgorod.
news.n_rus_kalita_fire: They say there was a great fire in Moscow and Kalita is rebuilding the town.
news.n_rus_sergius_hermit: They say that near Radonezh a young man named Bartholomew has built a cell and a little church in the forest.
news.n_rus_kalita_dies: Ivan Kalita has died. His son Semyon, called the Proud, is now grand prince.
news.n_rus_caffa: Genoese from Caffa say a plague has broken out in the besieging Tatar army.
news.n_rus_magnus: King Magnus of Sweden came to convert the Novgorod lands to the Latin faith. The Novgorodians drove him off.
news.n_rus_europe_plague: Merchants from Gotland say that across the sea whole cities are dying.
news.n_rus_semyon_dies: Grand Prince Semyon the Proud and his sons have died of the plague in Moscow.
news.n_rus_janibek: Khan Janibek has been killed in the Horde. They say great turmoil is beginning among the Tatars.
news.n_rus_ivan_dies: Grand Prince Ivan the Fair has died; his heir Dmitry is nine, and Metropolitan Alexius governs.
news.n_rus_blue_waters: Grand Duke Algirdas of Lithuania has beaten the Tatars at the Blue Waters and taken Kiev under his rule.
news.n_rus_ushkuiniki_nizhny: Novgorod river raiders have robbed merchants near Nizhny Novgorod.
news.n_rus_litovshchina: Algirdas reached Moscow, but the new stone Kremlin held. And far to the east, they say, the Mongol khans have been driven out of China.
news.n_rus_timur: Merchants from Sarai talk of a lame emir, Timur, who has seized power in Samarkand.
news.n_rus_kostroma: River raiders have taken Kostroma and gone off down the Volga. And in Novgorod the Strigolniki have been executed.
news.n_rus_vozha: Prince Dmitry has beaten the Horde commander Begich on the Vozha. For the first time the Horde has been defeated in open battle.
news.n_rus_kulikovo_news: On Kulikovo Field Dmitry of Moscow has defeated Mamai!
news.n_rus_tokhtamysh_news: Khan Tokhtamysh has taken Moscow by trickery and burned it.
news.n_rus_jogaila: Grand Duke Jogaila of Lithuania has been baptised a Latin and become King of Poland.
news.n_rus_donskoy_dies: Dmitry Donskoy has died. And news from the south: the Turks have beaten the Serbs on the Field of Kosovo.
news.n_rus_sergius_dies: Abbot Sergius of Radonezh has died.
news.n_rus_timur_yelets: Timur has crushed Tokhtamysh and taken Yelets. The Vladimir icon was brought to Moscow, and Timur turned back.
news.n_rus_vorskla: On the Vorskla the Tatars have beaten Grand Duke Vytautas of Lithuania.
news.n_rus_ankara: Merchants say Timur has defeated the Turkish sultan and put him in a cage.
news.n_rus_rublev: Theophanes the Greek, the elder Prokhor and the monk Andrei Rublev have painted the Annunciation Cathedral in the Kremlin.
news.n_rus_edigey: Emir Edigu besieged Moscow and ravaged all around it, but could not take the Kremlin and left with a ransom.
news.n_rus_grunwald: The Poles and Lithuanians have defeated the Teutonic Knights at Grunwald.
news.n_rus_hus: German merchants say a Czech preacher, Jan Hus, has been burned at Constance.
news.n_rus_novgorod_coins: Novgorod has begun minting its own silver coins.
news.n_rus_sergius_relics: The relics of Sergius of Radonezh have been found; crowds are flocking to the Trinity monastery.
news.n_rus_vasily_i_dies: Vasily I has died; Yury of Zvenigorod, uncle of the young Vasily, refuses to recognise his nephew.
news.n_rus_vytautas: Grand Duke Vytautas of Lithuania has died without ever receiving his crown.
news.n_rus_yury_moscow: Yury of Zvenigorod has taken Moscow. The civil war is flaring up.
news.n_rus_zosima: They say the monks Zosima and Savvaty have founded a monastery on the Solovetsky Islands in the White Sea.
news.n_rus_isidore: Metropolitan Isidore has returned from the council at Florence with a union with the Latins. The grand prince has had him arrested.
news.n_rus_suzdal_battle: Near Suzdal the Tatars have defeated and captured Grand Prince Vasily.
news.n_rus_jonas: A council of Russian bishops has made Jonas metropolitan on its own, without Constantinople.
news.n_rus_tsargrad_falls: Constantinople has fallen! The Turkish sultan has ridden into Holy Wisdom.
news.n_rus_yazhelbitsy: By the Peace of Yazhelbitsy Novgorod has promised not to shelter Moscow's enemies.
news.n_rus_kiev_metropolis: The Patriarch of Constantinople has appointed a separate Metropolitan of Kiev for Lithuania. Now Rus has two metropolitans.
news.n_rus_ivan_iii: Vasily the Dark has died. His son Ivan is now grand prince.
news.n_rus_nikitin_leaves: The Tver merchant Afanasy Nikitin has set off with a caravan down the Volga.
news.n_rus_kazan_war: Muscovite regiments have campaigned against Kazan.
news.n_rus_shelon_news: The Muscovite regiments have routed the Novgorodians on the Shelon.
news.n_rus_sophia: Grand Prince Ivan has married Sophia Palaiologina, niece of the last Greek emperor.
news.n_rus_nikitin_notes: The notebooks of the late merchant Afanasy Nikitin have been brought to Moscow: he had been to India, "beyond three seas".
news.n_rus_dormition: The Italian Aristotle Fioravanti has finished the new Dormition Cathedral in the Kremlin, bright as a single great hall.
news.n_rus_ugra_news: Khan Akhmat stood on the Ugra and left. The Horde's yoke is over!
news.n_rus_tver_annexed: Ivan III has taken Tver. The principality of Tver is no more.
news.n_rus_kazan_taken: Moscow has taken Kazan and put its own khan on the throne there.
news.n_rus_vyatka: A Muscovite army has brought the free land of Vyatka to submission.
news.n_rus_year_7000: The year 7000 since the Creation has arrived and the world did not end. And a Genoese named Columbus, they say, has sailed west to look for India.
news.n_rus_hansa_closed: Ivan III has closed the German Court in Novgorod and thrown the Hanseatic merchants into prison.
news.n_rus_sudebnik: A law code has been issued: peasants may leave their masters only around St George's Day.
news.n_rus_vedrosha: On the Vedrosha the Muscovite commanders have beaten the Lithuanians and captured their hetman.
news.n_rus_monastic_lands: A church council has argued over whether monasteries should own villages. Nil Sorsky says no, Joseph of Volokolamsk says yes.
news.n_rus_ivan_iii_dies: Sovereign Ivan III has died. His son Vasily is on the throne.
news.n_rus_pskov: Pskov has been annexed to Moscow and its veche bell taken away. The elder Philotheus writes: "Two Romes have fallen, the third stands, and there shall be no fourth."
news.n_rus_smolensk: Moscow has taken Smolensk, but at Orsha the Lithuanians have beaten the Muscovite army.
news.n_rus_luther: German merchants talk of a monk named Luther who is arguing with the Pope.
news.n_rus_mehmed_giray: The Crimean khan Mehmed Giray reached Moscow itself and drove off a multitude of captives.
news.n_rus_novodevichy: The Novodevichy convent has been founded in memory of the taking of Smolensk.
news.n_rus_solomonia: Grand Prince Vasily has had his childless wife Solomonia veiled as a nun.
news.n_rus_ivan_born: An heir, Ivan, has been born to the grand prince. They say a fearful thunderstorm raged on the night of his birth.
news.n_rus_vasily_iii_dies: Grand Prince Vasily III has died. His widow Elena Glinskaya rules for their three-year-old son.
news.n_rus_kopeck: There is a new coin, the kopeck, showing a horseman with a spear. Old clipped coins must be handed in.
news.n_rus_glinskaya: The regent Elena Glinskaya has died suddenly. People whisper the boyars poisoned her.
news.n_rus_oka: The Crimean khan reached the Oka, saw the Muscovite regiments and cannon, and turned back.
news.n_rus_boyar_rule: The Shuisky and Belsky boyars tear power from one another, and the young sovereign grows up amid their quarrels.
news.n_rus_tsar: Ivan Vasilyevich has been crowned tsar.
news.n_rus_streltsy: A new law code has been issued and a musketeer army raised.
news.n_rus_chancellor: An English ship has arrived at the mouth of the Dvina: its captain was looking for a way to China and found Moscow.
news.n_rus_astrakhan: Astrakhan has been taken; the whole Volga is now Muscovite. Feeding posts have been abolished.
news.n_rus_livonia: The tsar has begun a war with Livonia for access to the sea.
news.n_rus_st_basil: The Cathedral of the Intercession on Red Square is finished: nine churches on a single base.
news.n_rus_fedorov: Ivan Fyodorov has printed the Acts and Epistles in Moscow, a book made not by pen but by press. And Prince Kurbsky has fled to Lithuania and is writing the tsar accusing letters.
news.n_rus_oprichnina: The tsar has withdrawn to Aleksandrovskaya Sloboda and established the oprichnina.
news.n_rus_philip: Metropolitan Philip, who denounced the oprichnina, has been strangled in a monastery near Tver. And Poland and Lithuania have merged into one state.
news.n_rus_oprichnina_end: The tsar has abolished the oprichnina and forbidden even the mention of the word. And the Crimeans have been beaten at Molodi.
news.n_rus_simeon: The tsar has put a baptised Tatar, Simeon Bekbulatovich, on the throne and calls himself "little Ivan of Moscow".
news.n_rus_bathory: King Stefan Batory of Poland has retaken Polotsk.
news.n_rus_yermak: The Livonian War has ended in a truce. And the Cossack Yermak and his band have crossed the Urals and taken the Siberian khan's capital.
news.n_rus_ivan_iv_dies: Tsar Ivan Vasilyevich has died over a game of chess. His gentle son Fyodor is on the throne, and Boris Godunov governs.
news.n_rus_tsar_cannon: The master Andrei Chokhov has cast an enormous cannon, the Tsar Cannon.
news.n_rus_patriarch: The patriarchate has been established in Moscow; the first patriarch is Job.
news.n_rus_white_city: The stone wall of the White City around Moscow is finished.
news.n_rus_brest: News from Lithuania: some Orthodox bishops have accepted the authority of the Pope.
news.n_rus_godunov: Tsar Fyodor, the last of Kalita's line, has died. An assembly has elected Boris Godunov tsar.
news.n_rus_famine_starts: Rain and early frosts have ruined the grain. Famine is beginning.
news.n_rus_false_dmitry: A man calling himself the rescued Tsarevich Dmitry is advancing from Lithuania.
news.n_rus_godunov_dies: Tsar Boris has died suddenly. The pretender has ridden into Moscow.
